name: reset tutorial + pick range
eval: (()=>{for (const k of Object.keys(localStorage)) if (/tut/i.test(k)) localStorage.removeItem(k); document.getElementById('create-mode').value='range'; document.getElementById('create-room').click(); return 'room-line: '+document.getElementById('room-line').textContent.trim().slice(0,80)+' | hidden='+document.getElementById('room-line').hidden;})()

name: range state
eval: JSON.stringify({hudHidden: document.getElementById('hud').hidden, tutorial: document.getElementById('tutorial').hidden ? 'hidden' : document.getElementById('tutorial').textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,140), status: document.getElementById('status').textContent.replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,80), scoreboard: (document.getElementById('scoreboard').textContent.match(/\[BOT\]/g)||[]).length+' bots', skipBtn: !!document.querySelector('#tutorial button')})

name: move (tutorial step 1)
eval: (()=>{const k=(t,c)=>{const e=new KeyboardEvent(t,{code:c,key:c,bubbles:true}); window.dispatchEvent(e); document.dispatchEvent(e);}; k('keydown','KeyW'); setTimeout(()=>k('keyup','KeyW'),2500); return 'moving';})()

name: skip tutorial
eval: (()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>/skip tutorial/i.test(b.textContent)); if(!b) return 'no skip'; b.click(); return 'skipped';})()
